LF01_A.copy: LF01 Five Days, Five Pairs — hook image (the fireworks bench)
LF01_A.prompt: Night at a crowded theme park, photo taken with the iPhone flash from about 10 feet away by her daughter. A heavy-set plus-size woman about 52 (clearly US size 22, round face, heavy arms), tired and a little sad, sits alone on a green park bench wearing white socks; her sneakers are off and sitting empty on the pavement a foot away from her feet. Shopping bags, a plain solid-pink kid's backpack with no characters or prints, a souvenir light-up wand and water bottles piled on her lap and the bench; a folded stroller leaning on the bench. The flash makes her a bit washed out and the background dark; families walking away behind her, a small burst of fireworks far off in the sky. No castle, no logos, no characters. All bags, toys and shoes are plain and unbranded: no cartoon characters, no logos.

LF01_B.copy: LF01 — alt image (four failed pairs on the hotel carpet)
LF01_B.prompt: Taken looking straight down at a beige hotel-room carpet with the corner of a bed and a black rolling suitcase at the edge of the frame. Four pairs of worn women's sneakers lined up in a row, each pair with a strip of masking tape stuck to the carpet in front of it, handwritten in black marker: DAY 1, DAY 2, DAY 3, DAY 4. Day 1: grey slip-on memory foam sneakers. Day 2: chunky thick-soled cushioned running shoes. Day 3: white and black gym sneakers. Day 4: light grey running shoes with a pointed toe. All generic, unbranded, dusty and scuffed. A folded park map and a lanyard lie next to them. Yellow hotel lamp light mixed with the phone's own exposure, a bit grainy.

LF02_A.copy: LF02 The Shoe Graveyard — hook image (the bin)
LF02_A.prompt: A clear plastic storage bin on the stained concrete floor of a cluttered suburban garage, next to a lawnmower and paint cans, photographed from standing height looking down at an angle. The bin is overflowing, shoes piled above the rim, with worn-out women's work sneakers in navy, grey and white plus black clogs. A strip of masking tape across the lid with THE GRAVEYARD handwritten in black Sharpie. Lit by the dull overhead garage bulb and daylight from the open garage door. IMPORTANT about the shoes: every shoe has completely plain, smooth side panels in a single solid color, with no stripes, swooshes, letters, N or S marks, or patterns anywhere. Indoor work shoes: creased, scuffed and worn down, but clean, no mud.

Pale early light through the garage opening, windshield slightly fogged at the edges, phone exposure a little dark and noisy. IMPORTANT about the shoes: every shoe has completely plain, smooth side panels in a single solid color, with no stripes, swooshes, letters, N or S marks, or patterns anywhere. LF03_A.copy: LF03 Wish You Were Here — hook image (her café chair at the bottom of the hill, no person)
LF03_A.prompt: Taken sitting down at a small round metal café table on the sidewalk at the bottom of a very steep, narrow cobblestone street of small white and black stones in an old Portuguese hillside neighborhood in the early evening. On the table: an untouched glass of red wine and a phone lying face down. Under the table on the cobblestones: a pair of chunky white sneakers kicked off, one on its side, laces loose; nobody is wearing them and no feet are visible. The steep street climbs away toward old stone castle walls on the hilltop in the last daylight; a few small people walking up the hill. Tiled building fronts, laundry on balconies, parked scooters. Ordinary evening light, slightly overexposed sky, no golden glow.

LF03_B.copy: LF03 — alt image (the 'Wish you were here' text over the view he sent)
LF03_B.prompt: Phone photo taken from the top of an old stone castle wall at sunset, looking out over a European city of terracotta rooftops, church domes and a wide river, a man's hand resting on the stone wall in the lower corner. Sky blown out a little by the iPhone, orange and pink clouds, a few other tourists' heads at the edge of the frame. The lower third of the frame is darker rooftops in shadow.

LF04_A.copy: LF04 Christmas Morning From the Couch: hook image (the photo grandma posted)
LF04_A.prompt: Christmas morning in an ordinary American living room, photo taken by a grandmother standing near the hallway. In the foreground on the carpet, two kids (a boy about 6 and a girl about 12) in pajamas tearing open presents in piles of wrapping paper next to a decorated Christmas tree; a dad on his knees putting batteries into a toy. In the back of the frame, on the couch, a tired woman of about 45 still wearing navy blue hospital scrubs and a hospital ID badge, sitting slumped with both bare feet in a large metal mixing bowl of ice water on the rug, watching the kids from a distance with a tired half-smile. Morning window light mixed with yellow lamp light and tree lights, a little cluttered, coffee mugs on the side table. Plain unbranded toys and boxes, no characters or logos.

LF04_B.copy: LF04 alt image (7:50 a.m. Christmas morning in the hospital garage)
LF04_B.prompt: Taken from the driver's seat of a car parked in a concrete hospital parking garage just after dawn on Christmas morning. On the passenger seat: a pair of worn white and grey mesh work sneakers, the kind nurses wear, taken off, a hospital ID badge on a lanyard, and a small gift wrapped in red paper with a bow. A tiny Santa-hat air freshener hangs from the rear-view mirror. Pale early light through the garage opening, slightly dark and noisy phone exposure. IMPORTANT about the shoes: plain smooth side panels in a single solid color with no stripes, swooshes, letters or logos. Shot looking down at the passenger seat so only the edge of a plain steering wheel is visible; the steering wheel center pad is smooth and completely blank, with no emblem, badge or logo, and nothing on the dashboard carries a brand.
